race.title: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: INEDIT D'AMOUR has encouragingly got back on track returned to chasing this autumn and again confirmed himself on a competitive mark when finding only one too good at Bangor (17f) 24 days ago. A winner over hurdles at this venue, he's selected to confirm recent promise back over this longer trip. Gaelic Rambler will appreciate the return to larger obstacles, whilst Legendary Luke is surely capable of better than he showed on return/chase debut at Ffos Las. INEDIT D'AMOUR (FR) GAELIC RAMBLER (IRE) LEGENDARY LUKE (IRE)
